# dsh-skillhub-finder

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web plugin that puts a
**round SkillHub button inside the composer**, between the model selector and the send button.
Click it and it reads what you have typed, extracts the keywords that carry search intent,
searches [skillhub.cn](https://skillhub.cn) for skills that could help with that work, opens the
ranked results in the **right Sidebar**, and installs the one you pick.

> This is a **skill** finder, not a Cordis plugin store. SkillHub ships agent skills — `SKILL.md`
> bundles — so "download" here means *install the skill into your DSH skills root*, where the
> official filesystem skill provider picks it up without a restart.

## What it looks like

- **In the composer** — a 28px round button (`border-radius: 999px` + `corner-shape: round`, the
  shipped `.add` geometry), coloured from the same `--dsw-*` tokens as its neighbours. It is
  disabled until the draft has content, and spins while the search is in flight.
- **In the right Sidebar** — a `SkillHub 技能` tab. The tab title carries the live result
  count. `SkillHub 技能` also appears as a card on the Sidebar's guide page.

### A note on the seat

The composer tool row renders `conversation.input.right` **before** the model selector —
`InputBar.tsx` mounts it inside `.standardControls`, ahead of `conversation.input.model`, with the
Stop/Send buttons after that group. The requested position is the region to the *right* of the model
selector and to the *left* of send, so the button claims a later flex slot than the model seat:

```css
.skhf-btn { order: 2; }
```

That places it in the requested region without touching another plugin's entry. The only other seat
that sits after the model selector is `conversation.input.activity`, which is the wrong tool here:
an occupant of that seat expands across the toolbar and hides the ordinary accessory controls.

If a future DSH release mounts the seat in the order the name suggests, the `order` declaration
becomes a no-op and the button stays adjacent to the model selector, between it and send.

## Install

From a checkout of this directory, using the path form of `dsh plugin`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-skillhub-finder
```

Or from a packed tarball:

```sh
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-skillhub-finder-0.1.0.tgz
```

Then restart the profile. The profile patch inserts one Loader row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-skillhub-finder
      name: dsh-skillhub-finder
```

Remove it the same way, with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-skillhub-finder`.

## Use

1. Type what you are about to do — `帮我分析这份 Excel 并画图`, `帮我写周报`, `把这个 PDF 转成 Markdown`.
2. Click the round SkillHub button to the left of send.
3. The right Sidebar opens with the extracted keywords as chips and the ranked matches below.
4. **下载安装** installs a skill; **卸载** removes it; **查看主页** opens its skillhub.cn page.
5. **把首个技能插入输入框** hands the top recommendation's name back to the composer, so you can
   mention it in your next message.

## How the search works

Keyword extraction runs on the **Host**, not in the browser:

- Chinese candidates are gated on a **function-character deny list**: a 2- to 4-gram
  survives only when it contains no pronoun, particle or modal. That is what rejects the
  filler every request is full of. A stop-phrase list alone cannot do it — the n-grams that
  straddle two content words (`我想要`, `想要做`, `做一个`) score higher than the single real
  term beside them, and they were once the top keywords for a SpringBoot request.
- Terms are weighted, not counted. Curated **subject** terms (technologies, products, file
  formats: `springboot`, `excel`, `pdf`, `mysql`) outrank generic **intent** terms
  (`分析`, `周报`, `框架`), which outrank statistical n-grams. `我想要做一个springboot的后端框架`
  therefore yields `springboot` and `后端` — and drops `框架`, whose matches are
  "思维框架" and "记忆系统框架".
- English words are gated the same way, minus a filler list.

Each surviving keyword is searched against
`GET https://api.skillhub.cn/api/skills?keyword=…&sortBy=score`, then results are merged by
slug and ranked by **weight**, not by how many branches matched. Two evidence rules apply:

- A card only counts as a hit for a keyword when that keyword **actually appears** in the
  card's name, slug or summary. `sortBy=score` is a fuzzy tokenized recall, so the branch
  for `框架` returns stock analysers and social-media reports that do not contain the term
  at all.
- Name hits outweigh summary hits.

A skill whose search branch fails does not fail the whole search. When a draft carries no
subject term (`你好`), the search still runs on the line itself, the snapshot is flagged
`weak`, and the tab says the matches are a guess rather than pretending they are hits.

## Choosing where skills are installed

The install root is editable at runtime, from the tab itself — no profile edit, no restart:

1. Open the **SkillHub 技能** tab.
2. **更改** next to the current path opens the client's own folder picker.
3. Pick a directory. The Host validates it, creates it when missing, proves it is writable, and
   only then adopts it. **恢复默认** returns to `$DSH_HOME/skills`.

The chosen path is written into this plugin's own profile row through `ctx.configEditor.edit`, which
validates, persists and reconciles the Loader through the normal path — so it survives a restart, and
the Host reads its Config live so it also applies to the very next install. When that service is
missing or the write is refused, the path still takes effect for the session and the tab says why it
was not saved rather than pretending otherwise.

> `ctx.settings.update` is deliberately **not** used. It only addresses entries the settings
> projection considers *configurable*, and it refuses this plugin with
> `No configurable plugin entry "dsh-skillhub-finder"`, because a hand-written Standard Schema is not
> a projection it can surface. The config editor has no such precondition. Surfacing a real Settings
> page would additionally require a Schemastery `Config` with `.volatile()` fields — which is a
> module-load-time dependency this build-step-free plugin does not take.

## Configuration

The same value can be set up front in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-skillhub-finder
      name: dsh-skillhub-finder
      config:
        apiBase: https://api.skillhub.cn
        installDir: D:/skills
```

`apiBase` must be an absolute `http(s)` URL without credentials. `installDir` is validated both when
the plugin loads and whenever it changes: a relative path (it would resolve against whatever the
process cwd happens to be) and a filesystem root are refused, and `~` is expanded. The default is
`$DSH_HOME/skills`, i.e. `~/.dsh/skills`.

## Architecture

Two halves, one package.

**Host half** (`lib/index.js`) registers a same-origin route prefix
`/dsh-skillhub-finder/api` on `ctx.webServer` and owns every filesystem write:

| Route | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `POST /search` | extract keywords from the draft (or accept explicit ones), search, merge, mark installed |
| `GET /latest` | the last snapshot, so a reloaded page restores its results |
| `GET /meta` | API base, install directory, its default, writability, category labels |
| `GET /detail?slug=` | one skill's detail projection |
| `POST /install-dir` | validate, create and adopt a new skills root |
| `POST /install` | download the zip, unpack it into the skills root |
| `POST /uninstall` | remove an installed skill |

The browser never talks to `api.skillhub.cn` directly, so there is no cross-origin surface and the
zip is unpacked where the filesystem lives.

**Client half** (`lib/client.js`) is a hand-written lazy-CJS bundle — no bundler, no build step:

- `conversation.input.right` (list, session scope) — the round button. It reads the draft through
  the standard `useInput` prop, so no editor wiring is involved.
- `sidebar.right.pane.tab` + `sidebar.right.pane.tab.title` (keyed by the tab type's `id`) — the
  results page and its live chip title.
- `ctx.sidebarRightTabs.register({ id, kind: 'skillhub-finder', title, gu

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: connects the codebase-memory-mcp code graph, nudges the model at the decision point, corrects failed MCP calls, and indexes repositories by itself.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codebase-memory

[English](README_EN.md) | 中文

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.1-4d6bfe)

**把 [codebase-memory-mcp](https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp) 的代码图接进 DeepSeek Harness —— 不只是接上，而是让模型真的用它。**

代码图工具最常见的失败不是「接不上」，而是「接上了没人用」：提示写在 system prompt 开头，而决策发生在第 50 步。本插件把该做的事放到决策点上，包括**替模型建索引**。

---

## 安装

1. 先装 `codebase-memory-mcp`（见其上游 README），确认可用：

   ```sh
   codebase-memory-mcp --version
   ```

2. 在 DSH 的**插件管理器**里安装本插件（官方流程会同时完成包安装与 bundle 选择）：

   ```
   github:smter/dsh-codebase-memory#663d24657256321a82934289f5ba3a281be677f4
   ```

   > 已固定到该 commit；升级时换成新 commit，或改用 tag `v1.0.0`。

3. 重启 `dsh web`。之后 **Settings** 里会出现本插件两个行的选项。

> `codebase-memory-mcp` 不在 PATH 上时，改设置里的 `autoIndexCommand`，以及 MCP 行的 `command`。
> 若要顺带自愈「旧 daemon 世代」（见「已知限制」），把这两处指向本仓库自带的 `bin/cbm-mcp-preflight`。

## 它做什么

一个 bundle，三行：

| 行 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `codebase-memory-mcp` | 连接本地 stdio MCP 服务，工具以 `mcp__codebase-memory-mcp__*` 暴露 |
| `codebase-memory-reminder` | 往 system prompt 注入一段提示，每个 model step 都在 |
| `codebase-memory-nudge` | 在工具管线里按需出手：纠正报错、决策点提醒、**自动建索引** |

`codebase-memory-nudge` 的三件事，每件都有实测依据：

- **纠正失败的 MCP 调用** —— 报错时在下一次决策点注入「这次该怎么改」。
  实测：某项目 17 次 `search_graph` 中，带 `semantic_query` 键的 10 次**全部失败**（空数组 `[]` 也算），不带的 7 次**全部成功**；一个子代理因此连续重试 8 次后彻底放弃该工具。
- **决策点提醒** —— 刚 grep 源码、或刚读满 100 行以上源码时，在那次结果后面附一句。
  实测：只放 system prompt 时，某会话 12 次 MCP 调用中 10 次失败并很快放弃，另一会话 228 次工具调用里 **0 次**使用代码图。
- **自动建索引** —— 发现正在读的路径属于未索引的 git 仓库时，插件自己跑 `codebase-memory-mcp cli index_repository`，然后把**准确的 project 名**和可直接粘贴的调用交给模型。
  实测：某会话被要求建索引后，先建错了仓库、再建对，正确解析出 project 名、写下「use the daily graph」，然后**一次都没查**。所以这一步不让模型做。

## 前置条件

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`（本插件在该版本上验证）
- `codebase-memory-mcp` 已安装：MCP 行通过官方 `StdioClientTransport` 启动它，自动索引复用同一个可执行文件的 `cli` 一次性模式

## 设置

两个行都声明了 `Config` schema，选项会在 **Settings** 页自动成表单。常用几项：

| 设置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `autoIndex` | `true` | 自动为未索引的 git 仓库建索引 |
| `autoIndexMode` | `fast` | `fast` / `moderate` / `full` |
| `autoIndexMaxFiles` | `20000` | 超过此文件数的仓库不自动索引 |
| `autoIndexCommand` | `codebase-memory-mcp` | 可执行文件路径（走 PATH） |
| `minLines` | `100` | 读多少行以上算「读长源码」 |
| `cooldown` | `6` | 第 1 次提醒后每隔几次符合条件的调用再提醒 |
| `correctMCP` | `true` | 是否纠正失败的 MCP 调用 |

完整字段见 Settings 页，或 `index.js` / `hook.js` 里的 `Config`。

## 开发与测试

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
```

57 个用例，不需要网络或真实索引：

- `test/triggers.test.mjs` — 30 例：行数阈值、源码过滤器正反例、提醒节奏、消息形状
- `test/corrections.test.mjs` — 13 例：用**真实报错文本**驱动纠正规则（含 2026-10-14 的 daemon 世代冲突两条）
- `test/autoindex.test.mjs` — 14 例：用**桩可执行文件**驱动完整索引链路与全部 guard

设置 `CBM_DEBUG=1` 可看到自动索引被跳过的原因。

## 已知限制

- **PTC 模式下 Tool SDK 把多数 MCP 工具的参数渲染成 `unknown`**，模型只能靠描述猜参数名。本插件用 system prompt 写明调用签名来绕过；根因在渲染侧，值得上游修。
- **worktree 会被索引成独立 project**（worktree 里 `.git` 是文件）。这通常正是想要的，但主 checkout 的索引不会自动覆盖 worktree，反之亦然。
- `autoIndexMaxFiles` 是**有界遍历估算**（不读 `.gitignore`），只是粗粒度护栏。
- **旧 daemon 世代会锁死一切写入，而读调用照常成功** —— 二进制升级后，上一世代的 `codebase-memory-mcp` daemon 可能仍然活着：`index_repository` 报 `active daemon coordination could not be verified safely`（CLI 则拒绝启动，称存在 `pre-coordination or unverified` daemon），但 `list_projects` / `get_file_outline` / `search_graph` 全部正常返回 —— 因此极易被误判成「这个仓库没被索引 / 索引不支持这个语言」。本仓库自带 `bin/cbm-mcp-preflight`：启动前探一次，健康即原样 `exec`，冲突则杀掉旧 daemon、重探、再 `exec`（探针上限 ~4s，任何情况下都不挡住工具面；每次自愈写 `~/.cache/codebase-memory-mcp/logs/repairs.log`）。

  ```sh
  # 让 MCP 行与自动索引都走它（两边都要改；自动索引那次 spawn 是静默的）
  codebase-memory-mcp.command              = /path/to/bin/cbm-mcp-preflight
  codebase-memory-nudge.autoIndexCommand   = /path/to/bin/cbm-mcp-preflight
  ```

  手工兜底：`pkill -f 'codebase-memory-mcp --cbm-daemon-internal'`，然后原样重试原调用（CLI 会自建新世代）。
  `codebase-memory-nudge` 也会在报错文本里认出这两种串，就地注入上面这条修法。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Muse-like persistence for DSH: durable autonomy across restarts + silent proactive heartbeat
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-muse

> Give your [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) agent Muse-like persistence: authorize once, and it keeps working across restarts — plus a silent heartbeat that only speaks when there is something worth saying.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)

## What is this

Three DSH plugins + a set of experience recipes that replicate the core feel of [Meta Muse](https://introducing.muse.ai/): **one long-lived conversation where the agent watches, keeps going, and only speaks when it matters**.

| Piece | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`muse/`](muse/) — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-muse` | Persists your grant with proof of the original human message; a keeper re-arms disarmed active goals on session resume, so long-running goals survive process restarts |
| [`tool-muse/`](tool-muse/) — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-muse` | The `muse_autonomy` model tool: only a direct human request can grant or revoke autonomy; auto-continuations and subagents are always rejected |
| [`tool-memory/`](tool-memory/) — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-memory` | `memory_save` tool + per-turn memory injection over a human-editable plain-text memory file (`~/.dsh/memories/main.md`) — the "gets smarter over time" piece |
| [`docs/`](docs/) | Mechanism analysis, proactivity design (event-driven + speak/not-speak gate), install notes, release checklist |

Security boundary inherited from `dsh-goal`: activation never auto-inherits. Manual disarm always wins; paused/blocked goals are never auto-resumed.

## Install

Requires a DSH runtime whose plugin tree includes the goal family (`dsh-goal`, `dsh-goal-round-driver`).

```bash
# in your profile directory, e.g. ~/.dsh/profiles/web
dsh plugin --profile web add <published-package-or-git-url>   # both packages
```

Developing from a clone (verified on a fresh `git clone`):

```bash
pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm -r test && pnpm test:timers
```

Then add both bundles to your profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list, after the goal family. Packages carry their own `dsh.bundle.patch` metadata, so the plugin panel recognizes them as profile-level plugins. If your runtime version differs from the peer range, grant a per-profile compatibility exemption (`compatibility.json`).

A ready-made composition example lives at [composition example `examples/muse.cordis.yml`](examples/muse.cordis.yml) and install notes in [docs/install-notes.md](docs/install-notes.md).

## Experience it

1. **Continuous pursuit** — in a new session:
   > Create a long-term goal: `<your task>`. I'm leaving — keep going autonomously, don't ask me, until it's done.

   Watch it call `create_goal`, then `muse_autonomy { autonomy: true }`, then run goal rounds back to back.
2. **Survives restarts** — stop the runtime, start it again, reopen the session, say "continue". The keeper re-arms the goal from the persisted grant; no re-authorization needed.
3. **Silent heartbeat** — schedule a recurring check with "check but don't speak unless there's something worth saying" semantics. See [docs/experience-guide.md](docs/experience-guide.md) and [docs/proactivity-design.md](docs/proactivity-design.md).

## Docs

- [Continuous evolution](docs/evolution/README.md) — direction, bounded iteration contract, primary sources, scenario evaluation and evidence ledger. Start with `pnpm evolution:status`; validate with `pnpm evolution:check`.
- [docs/goals.md](docs/goals.md) — Muse ↔ DSH mechanism mapping, with evidence
- [docs/experience-guide.md](docs/experience-guide.md) — how to feel each capability
- [docs/proactivity-design.md](docs/proactivity-design.md) — proactive trigger design (event-driven, wake ≠ interrupt)
- [docs/gaps.md](docs/gaps.md) — what's implemented vs. what Muse has that we don't (event ingress, memory seam, external notify)
- [docs/install-notes.md](docs/install-notes.md) — cross-version install gotchas (metadata, exemptions, hot-mount)
- [docs/FAQ.md](docs/FAQ.md) — common errors and fixes
- [docs/capability-checklist.md](docs/capability-checklist.md) — historical Muse capability inventory; current priorities and evidence live in the evolution ledger
- [docs/today-app-notes.md](docs/today-app-notes.md) — teardown notes of Today.app (another Muse-like) with adoptable patterns
- [examples/habits/](examples/habits/) — cross-project habit miner (feeds proactive ideas)
- [examples/gate/](examples/gate/) — out-of-conversation proactive gate: zero-trace checks, inject only when it matters
- [docs/heartbeat-recipes.md](docs/heartbeat-recipes.md) — copy-paste silent-heartbeat / proactive-report recipes
- [docs/release-checklist.md](docs/release-checklist.md) — what "GitHub-ready" means here

## Status

The timer-first loop has package and CLI integration tests, including real AgentLoop + JSONL cold recovery. Current work focuses on bounded progress in the same conversation, waiting/completion state and quiet reflection; external events and other conversations are deferred. See [docs/timer-first.md](docs/timer-first.md) for behavior, verification and remaining limits.

## License

MIT

[Timer-first progress loop / 定时推进闭环](docs/timer-first.md) — same-session routines, waiting/completion state, native cold wake, non-human mailbox delivery and proposal-only reflection.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-perf-hud > **纯客户端性能 HUD**:右下角一块浮层,回答"现在卡不卡、卡在谁身上"。 > 帧与最差帧 · Longtask(带四条腿归因)· 每插件回调速率与同步耗时 · DOM 增长与写入者 · JS 堆 · > 宿主 event-loop 与链路 RTT · 证据包导出 · 守夜(偶发卡顿的事后回看)· > **守夜层:偶发卡顿自动留存最差几次,连证据一次性导出**。

🌏 中文 · English

> ✅ **v0.6.0 已发布到 npm** —— `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-perf-hud` 即可(发布门槛与未还的债见 > [REVIEW.md](REVIEW.md))。 ## 📑 目录 - [✨ 它回答什么问题](#-它回答什么问题) - [🧭 和 DSH 自带开发者工具的分工](#-和-dsh-自带开发者工具的分工) - [🚀 安装](#-安装) - [📊 面板怎么读](#-面板怎么读) - [🛰️ 偶发卡顿:守夜层](#️-偶发卡顿守夜层) - [🔬 四条腿归因](#-四条腿归因) - [🧪 隔离实验(已移到控制台)](#-隔离实验已移到控制台) - [⚠️ 风险与边界(必读)](#-风险与边界必读) - [🧰 控制台 API 与存储键位](#-控制台-api-与存储键位) - [🛠️ 开发与测试](#️-开发与测试) - [🤝 参与贡献](#-参与贡献) ## ✨ 它回答什么问题 | 问题 | 面板给的答案 | |---|---| | 现在顺不顺? | FPS / 最差帧 / 帧内未归因;标题栏常显「流式 / 空闲 Ns」作为解读前提 | | 卡的那一下是谁干的? | Longtask 明细 + 四条腿归属(组件名 / 包名 / DOM 写入者) | | 哪个插件在偷偷跑? | 按插件的回调执行速率(/s)、峰值速率、同步耗时;DOM 写入次数与写入者 | | 是插件的问题还是宿主/链路的问题? | 宿主 event-loop p50/p99/max + 链路 RTT/吞吐,附阈值判色与「链路已排除」结论 | | 关掉某个插件到底有没有用? | 隔离实验(控制台):逐个关闭 60 秒,和紧邻基线对照,并给出噪声底 | ## 🧭 和 DSH 自带开发者工具的分工 DSH 自带的实验性**开发者工具**(插件管理器官方分组,`NodeJS 诊断` / `会话数据诊断`)是**前台显微镜**:断点、Host console、网络抓包、原始 session 日志、Cordis 树。本插件是**行车记录仪**:默认常开,记帧、LoAF、事件计时,事后给事故包。 | 想回答 | 用 | |---|---| | 现在为什么慢 / 断点 / 网络 / 会话日志 / Cordis 树 | 开发者工具 | | 刚刚那一下有多慢、是谁、能不能复盘 | 本插件 | 两边不互相依赖。开发者工具的 Performance **只采 Host CPU**,Client 侧只有 Console 求值与只读 Sources,**不给页面渲染 trace / 帧数据**;所以本插件事故包里的 `devtools-trace` 缺失仍然如实保留,不会因为装了它就变成"已补上"。它也**抓全量 Host fetch(含密钥)**,与本插件"导出前减法脱敏"是两套口径。 快捷键:`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+U` 展开/收起(macOS / Windows;Linux Web 的平台白名单不允许这个组合,未绑定;收起/展开不抢输入框焦点)。 ## 🛰️ 偶发卡顿:守夜层 面板要你盯着看;偶发卡顿恰恰发生在你没看的时候。所以插件**默认开着一层不插桩的记录器**: - 每帧一条**帧级环形缓冲**(12000 条 ≈ 60fps 下 3.3 分钟),另加一个 LoAF 观察器(Chrome 123+); - 一帧超过 **100ms**(或 LoAF 的 `blockingDuration` 超过 100ms)就**自动抓一次**:前 10 秒 + 后 3 秒**原样切片**,不等你反应; - 留存取**三档并集**:全局最差 **10** 次 + **每天最差 1 条**(最多最近 7 天,清单里标「当天最差」)+ **最近 3 次**(不看严重度,标「最近一次」)—— 只按全局最差排时,同一小时里的 10 次会把"昨天下午那次卡"整条挤掉(实测 `捕获 40 · 丢弃 38`)。抓到了但没留存下来的次数单独记(`dropped`),与"没抓到"分开; - 事故包把脚本 URL 抽成一张表(`urls` + `scripts[].u`):同一个 combo URL 会被写几十遍,抽表之后**一份小 4 倍**(实测 116.6KB → 29.6KB),信息一点没丢; - 落盘另有 **3MB** 字节上限,超了就从最弱的开始裁(最近档最后动);配额真的不够时**先丢掉可重建的 sourcemap 分段表**,再谈裁证据 —— 裁掉的条数写在常显那一行的「裁掉 N」里,内存按同一份裁(看到的永远等于刷新后还在的)。(上限原本是 512KB,但实测一个晚上就被裁了 6 次、实际只留得下 8 条):刷新页面、重启浏览器之后还在,`watch().restored` 告诉你这次读回了几条;写不进去会如实报 `persistError`,不假装存下来了; - **"发生了几次"和"留了几份现场"是两个数,分开算**(产品计划 §3.A):留存清单受容量限制,**它的条数不能回答"最近卡了几次"** —— 被挤掉的卡顿不是没发生。所以另有一层轻量计数:每分钟一个桶、只留最近 24 小时,再按天汇总 30 天(跨刷新)。三个数各有各的名字,面板悬停里都写着: - **检测到 = triggered** —— 起过几次捕获。一次卡顿通常是一串触发,而**这一串只算一次**;被并进同一次 pending(或落进已覆盖窗口)的那些触发**不算新的一次**; - **同串触发(coalesced)** —— 上面那一串里被并掉的触发个数。它是"这一串有多密",**不是次数**:把两者相加会把一次停顿记成十几次(在真页面上实测踩过,一次 3 秒的后摇里每帧都触发一次); - **已保存现场 = 留存清单的条数** —— 受容量限制(最差 10 次 + 每天 1 条 + 最近 3 次),**不等于**检测到; - **丢失 = (triggered − captured) + dropped + trimmed + failed** —— 起过捕获却没能切成现场 / 抓到了但没留存下来 / 字节装不下被裁 / 写盘失败,单列,不混进"检测到"。 折叠药丸上那一格 `检测 N 次` 说的是**最近 24 小时**(跨刷新),不是留存份数;悬停里三个数各自的名字与口径都写着(`__perfHud.tally()` 同一个口径)。 - 标签页隐藏造成的几百秒"间隙"**不算卡顿**(rAF 被挂起),事故包里标成 `gap`; - 这一层**不包装任何原型**:只用本来就在跑的 rAF 循环与一个 `PerformanceObserver`,所以默认开着也不改你的环境。 ```js __perfHud.watch() // 在不在录、覆盖多少秒、LoAF 装没装上、抓到几次 __perfHud.incidents() // 最差几次的摘要(索引 0 最差) __perfHud.report(0) // 完整事故包:帧序列 + LoAF 条目 + 窗口内 longtask + 环境读数 __perfHud.exportIncident(0) // 下载成 JSON —— 把这份丢给分析的人(或 agent)就行 __perfHud.capture('切了视图') // 手动标记"刚刚卡了一下"(自动回退 3 秒的反应时间) __perfHud.clearIncidents() // 只清事故;clear() 刻意不动它 ``` 事故包里的脚本**会定到包名**:合并批(58 个包挤在一个 URL 里)靠"字符位置 → 行号 → sourcemap 分段表"还原,单包 URL 直接从 URL 读;拿不到时写清为什么(精确归因没开 / 文本还在拉 / 越界),并按包给一份汇总 —— 这一层才是"是谁"。 导出文件名是 **`perf-hud-20261008-220358-i84.json`** —— 事故发生时刻的本地时间 + 事故 id(不是导出时刻;日期在前可排序,完整 ISO 在文件体里)。 **看的是哪一帧、怎么翻**:圆环上面有一行 `帧 1/12 · 530ms · ≥100ms ◀ ▶ ⟲` —— 判据与排序统一用 `frameSeverity = max(blocking, 帧时长)`:清单只收最近 200 条长动画帧里**值得回看的**(**帧时长 ≥ 100ms**,与守夜触发线同一条;刚过 50ms 的边角帧不进榜),排序也按 `max(blocking, 帧时长)`、最差的排第一(**blocking 只是补充** —— 只看它会把 92ms 的帧排到 300ms 的帧前面);一条都不到线时退回显示全部(那时标签上不出现 `≥100ms`)。默认是**自动**:一直跟着最差那条走(所以没有更差的出现时,它不会变);按 ◀ ▶ 换一条看,就**钉住**那一条,⟲ 回到自动。选中的那条被挤出 200 条之后会自动退回自动,不会指着一个已经不在环里的帧。 **长动画帧的时间去哪了**:「取证明细」里有一张**恒定四段**的圆环(84px),段与段之间留 1.4px 缝: - **脚本**(被 LoAF 归到脚本的同步 JS)= 红;**任务**里没归到脚本的那部分(短于上报阈值的脚本 + 事件派发 / 微任务 / GC)= 中性灰;**渲染**(rAF 回调)= 橙;**样式+布局+绘制** = 蓝。 环只说这一件事("帧的时间分给了谁")。**脚本内部"是谁"、以及"哪个包"另画两条 100% 堆叠横条**(紧接着的「按来源」「按包」两行:上面是每项一行的小表(名字左、毫秒右),下面一条是占比;段越靠左越重(不透明,名次靠压暗而不是变透明),段间 1px 缝,小段保底 3px;鼠标停上去给 `名字 毫秒 · 占比`;顶段 ≥ 80% 时条右边会内联一个占比,例如 `86%`)。**两个维度交叉**的问题("哪个包的哪类回调")交给再下面那张**可折叠的交叉表**,默认收起,展开是 Top3 × Top3 + 其余行列。**悬停联动整体停用、辅助代码已删干净**(环 ↔ 按来源/按包堆叠条 ↔ 交叉表):2026-10-08 实测「鼠标指到交叉表的行标签会让整个面板被外壳停用」,而且它**不经过我们自带的那层错误边界**(连错误原文都拿不到);2026-10-11 在当前代码上又**复现不出来** —— 既不能证明根因、也不能证明已修好,所以保持停用(见「风险与边界」第 9 条);环、两条堆叠条与交叉表本身照常工作。小表的**每一行可点**(点了复制「名字 + 毫秒」到剪贴板,成功/失败都照实显示),但**堆叠条的色段本身不可点** —— 它只是同一份数据的比例视图,没有别的去处。 **这是页面内能拆到的极限**:绘制与合成在页面内分不开(要分开只能录 Chrome trace),所以最后一段是"剩下的都在这儿"。 **脚本那一侧再拆三层、两个分母**:「本帧」那组第一行(以及窗口组在非全纯执行时的对应行)把脚本耗时拆成 纯执行 / 强制样式布局 / 暂停 —— **三者是分区,相加 = 脚本耗时**,不是另加的时间(`forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration` 是读布局 / 写样式逼出来的同步布局,`pauseDuration` 是同步 XHR、对话框把它卡住的时间)。 再往下是**同一份脚本耗时的两种切法**,由两个小标题分成两组: - **「本帧」**= 上面那张饼的**同一帧**(数字能和饼对着看);**「窗口」**= 最近 200 条 LoAF 的累计,范围就写在小标题上:`窗口:200 条长动画帧 · 跨 43分12秒 · 平均每帧脚本 108.1ms`。范围写在标题上,行标签就不用每行重复"本帧 / ·窗口"。 - **按来源**(LoAF 的 `invoker`):这条脚本**是谁调起来的** —— `setTimeout`、`DOMWebSocket.onmessage`(会话事件流的消息处理器,实测最常见)、`Response.json.then`(Promise 回调)、`script`(脚本加载)…… 覆盖全部脚本,所以合计 = 脚本耗时。 - **按包**:单包 URL 直接读出来,合并批按 sourcemap 分段还原(与事故包 `incident.packages` 同一条路)。**只覆盖"定得到包名"的脚本**,所以合计 ≤ 脚本耗时;**第一名是应用外壳 bundle 时(如 `index-CN7NIWNw.js`),紧接着会有一行"最大一块来自应用外壳(不是插件)"** —— 那是宿主 / React 根那一层,从来不属于任何插件,它排第一**不等于**某个插件是元凶(脚本毫秒是直接测量的,归属是推断的);名字后面会跟一段 **「其余来源」**,那是定不到插件包名的部分,而且**按原因给名字**:`无 URL(内联脚本)`(内联 / 动态构造的处理器)、`插件批次(未按 sourcemap 拆)`(URL 在 `plugins/` 下但还没拆)、或者**直接就是文件名**(比如 `index-5SrrfWpU.js` —— 那是应用自己的外壳 bundle,React 根容器上的事件处理器就来自它,它本来不属于任何插件)。**先看「其余来源」那段有多少毫秒,再读排行。** - 这一层只回答"**哪一类调用**",不回答"函数里面慢在哪":函数级要 Chrome trace(JS Self-Profiling 被 `Document-Policy` 挡着,页面内没有采样器,实测 `new Profiler()` 直接抛 `NotAllowedError`)。 **只有"平均每帧脚本"那一栏和饼可比**(饼是单帧;除数其实是**帧数**,不是脚本条数);`纯执行 21623.8ms` 这种是 200 条各百来毫秒攒出来的累计,不是某一次执行花了 21 秒 —— 跨度越久累计越大。值超过一行时按块式换行(左对齐),不挤标签。 **面板会自己藏掉没意义的行**(字太多本身就会让人读不动):「**回调归因**」那一块**总在「开发者详情 · 帧与归因」里**,没开「深录」时降级成一行 —— 标签 `回调归因(耗时·下界)` + 值 `要深录`(Top3 表与「其余 (N)」行都不渲染;**绝不写 `0ms/s`**,那会被读成"没有开销");插桩之后 `0ms/s` 才是**真的**(确实没有回调跑过那次调度点)。`DOM 写入` 同样只在插桩后显示(不插桩时计数恒为 0)。`帧内未归因` 与组摘要里的未归因直接写"要深录"—— 不插桩时那个数会退化成平均帧间隔,给数就是误导;一个包名都没定到时,「按包」那条**既不会空、也不会摆一行"0 条定到名"** —— 喂给堆叠条的就是 `whoRows(tally)`(定到名的部分 + 按原因命名的「其余来源」),所以那种情况看到的是 `插件批次(未按 sourcemap 拆)` / `无 URL(内联脚本)` / 外壳文件名这些**带名字与毫秒**的段;没定到名的原因是合并批要靠 sourcemap 还原,而那条路只在「深录」(精确归因)打开时才拉。 **「取证明细」组的最前面是一条 60 秒帧条**(从右对齐的窄条改成**铺满一行的块**,约 365px 宽、一格约 6px):一格一秒,柱高 = 那一秒里最差那一帧的间隔,颜色与导出件 ASCII 条带用**同一组阈值**(≥100ms 红 / ≥50ms 黄);每格 hover 给墙钟时间 + 那一秒最差帧多少 + **点得动还是点不动** —— 只有那一秒**真的有长动画帧**(LoAF 环里存在)的格子才可点,点了就把翻帧切到那条帧;点不动的格子明确不给手型,并在 title 里说明。整格都是 rAF 挂起的那一秒画成最矮的灰柱 —— 它是间隙,不是卡顿。展开着不动也能看出"这分钟哪几秒抖了"。 **取证明细一次只服务一个上下文** —— **实时监控**(实时帧环里的当前帧)或**历史事故**(选中事故里的一条历史帧),详情区第一行的上下文标题会写明是哪一支(`实时监控 · 当前帧` / `历史事故 i12 · 历史帧 3/305`)。从实时进历史按「看这一帧」,回实时按「回到实时」;切上下文只切数据源,实时采集与另一侧的选中都不动,刷新后也停在同一条事故的同一帧(上下文落盘,事故/帧找不到就退回自动)。 历史事故那一支的「历史帧时间轴」画的是**选中的那条事故**当时那一段窗口,数据**全部来自事故包**(`incident.frames` / `incident.loaf` / `summary` / `longTasks`),所以**刷新生效**,而且**不增加任何采集成本**。横轴**按时间**放、最多 240 列,**每列取该列最差的那一帧**,点击选中的一定是包里**真实存在**的那一帧;整段 rAF 被挂起 / 采样缺失的地方**留白**,一眼看出"这段时间根本没在测",不是没卡(按序号放会把那个间隔压成一根柱子,那就等于说谎);档位与实时帧条用**同一个函数**、同一组 theme token,两处读数不许打架。下面依次是**范围**(窗口跨度 / 帧数 / p50 / p99 / 最差帧 / 缺口数)、**归因状态**(已确认 / 可疑 / 未归因)、选中帧的**序号 / 耗时 / 档位**与翻帧控件(◀ 上一帧 / 下一帧 ▶,加一个「只看异常」过滤器 —— 开着时步长只落在帧间隔 ≥ 守夜触发线的帧上;没有下一条就禁用)、**这一帧的时间去向**(帧内四段分解,相加 = 这一帧时长)、与这一帧重叠的 **Long Task**、以及**可疑脚本**;它们都在默认折叠的「技术细节」里。⚠️ **两条真实限制**:① **不排帧内执行顺序** —— LoAF 只给每条脚本的耗时,不给它在帧内的起止;② 没有**完整函数级时间轴**(函数名常缺失,页

plugins.readme_text:
# @dsh-remote/relay

DSH Remote Control 的**零知识 WebSocket 中继**：在宿主插件与已配对的手机之间转发**密封记录**，
只认帧名 / 会话 id / 协议版本闸，**从不解析载荷**——密文对它就是一个 base64 字符串。

生产形态是**单文件产物** `dist/bundle/main.js`（`ws` / `zod` / 协议层全部内联，运行时零依赖）；
部署只有两种：拷这个单文件 + 起进程（systemd / docker / nginx 配方见下），或从源码构建。

## 自托管

完整配方（环境变量表、systemd / docker / nginx、排错、升级）见
[`docs/SELF-HOSTING.md`](docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)。最速验证：

```sh
DRC_HOST_TOKEN=<与主机插件一致> node dist/bundle/main.js
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/healthz
```

### 常用配置

| 变量                          | 必填 | 默认        | 说明                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------- | ---- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `DRC_HOST_TOKEN`              | ✅   | —           | 主机出站认证凭据。`openssl rand -hex 32` 生成。**与主机插件那份必须逐字一致**                                                             |
| `DRC_PORT`                    |      | `8787`      | 监听端口。`0` = 让系统分配（测试与容器用）                                                                                                |
| `DRC_BIND`                    |      | `127.0.0.1` | 绑定地址。默认只绑回环：TLS 由反代终止。**只有自己就是边缘（容器直接发布端口）时才设 `0.0.0.0`**                                          |
| `DRC_PUBLIC_URL`              |      | 空          | `/api/info` 返回的对外地址。公网填 `wss://你的域名`                                                                                       |
| `DRC_LOG_LEVEL`               |      | `info`      | `debug` / `info` / `warn` / `error` / `silent`。**区分大小写**                                                                            |
| `DRC_PAIR_TTL_MS`             |      | `120000`    | 配对码的**服务端权威**寿命（毫秒）                                                                                                        |
| `DRC_MP_APPID`                |      | —           | 小程序 appid。与 `DRC_MP_SECRET` 同时配置才启用 `GET /code`（生成小程序码）；不配则插件回退旧 `dshr:` 码                                  |
| `DRC_MP_SECRET`               |      | —           | 小程序 secret。**只放在中继**，永不进插件包；换了 secret 记得同步这里                                                                     |
| `DRC_MP_ENV`                  |      | `release`   | 小程序码打开哪一版：`release` / `trial` / `develop`。**新版只上了体验版时必须设 `trial`**，否则码把用户带进老版本（能扫进去、配对必失败） |
| `DRC_STATE_FILE`              |      | 空（关闭）  | 会话表落盘路径。默认关闭 = 纯内存；配上后启动先读它、会话表有增删时写回                                                                   |
| `DRC_STATE_SAVE_MS`           |      | `60000`     | 周期补写状态文件的间隔（只为刷新 `lastActivityAt`）                                                                                       |
| `DRC_MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES`      |      | `1048576`   | 慢消费者阈值：发送缓冲区**连续**超限达**本角色窗口**才 1008 断开                                                                          |
| `DRC_SLOW_CONSUMER_HOST_MS`   |      | `10000`     | **主机**侧慢消费者窗口（毫秒）。主机卡住就是所有人卡住，所以窗口短                                                                        |
| `DRC_SLOW_CONSUMER_CLIENT_MS` |      | `45000`     | **客户端**侧慢消费者窗口（毫秒）。**必须大于手机自己的重连周期**（≈42.5 秒）                                                              |

### 端点

| 路径                   | 说明                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `GET /healthz`         | 运维契约（**二十四个字段**）：`ok` / `version` / `uptimeSec` / `hosts` / `clients` / `conversations` / `pendingPairs` / `hostTokens` / `droppedFrames` / `slowConsumers` / `rejectedPairs` / `shutdownForced` / `persistence` / `stateRestored` / `stateSavedAtSec` / `stateWrites` / `stateWriteFailures` / `lastPingAgo` / `shuttingDown` / `protocolSelf` / `protocolMin` / `peerProtocolMin` / `peerProtocolMax` / `peersNoProtocol` |
| `GET /api/info`        | `{"publicUrl","protocol"}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `GET /api/pair-status` | **默认 404**。无需认证地回答"配对码 N 是否有效"等于给 6 位码空间装了扫描 oracle；确需调试时 `DRC_PAIR_STATUS=1`，用完关掉                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| WebSocket              | 路径不设限，任意路径都能升级                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

落盘五字段（`persistence` / `stateRestored` / `stateSavedAtSec` / `stateWrites` /
`stateWriteFailures`）是"还在落盘"的唯一读数——换机器先看 `stateWriteFailures`，不是 0 就是没在写。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build        # tsc + 单文件打包
pnpm test         # tsc + 打包 + node --test（含产物级判据）
```

## 红线

- **不 import 载荷**：依赖图里只有协议层的 `frames` / `ids` / `negotiate` / `outbound`；
  构建产物里不许出现任何密码学实现——`tests/bundle.test.mjs` 直接读产物断言。
- 路由表是**内存的**：重启即全部作废（客户端会看到 `unknown_session`），这是设计不是缺陷。
- 日志永不落载荷、落完整配对码、落 hostToken（有判据锁住）。
- **本包不发 npm**：`private: true`，发布流程里不许出现发包步骤与 id-token（有判据）。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: BharatCode and OpenAI-compatible provider setup alongside ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot subscriptions for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Provider Hub

A small installable DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds **Settings → Providers**:

- **BharatCode** preset with Qwen and DeepSeek model entries, API-key setup and live catalog discovery.
- **OpenAI-compatible endpoints**, using either Chat Completions or Responses, including localhost gateways.
- **ChatGPT (Codex), GitHub Copilot and other subscriptions**, by embedding the settings component from an installed `dsh-plugin-subscriptions` plugin. That plugin owns OAuth, refresh, quotas and subscription adapters.

The hub uses DSH's native `llm-pi-ai` adapter and authenticated settings/credentials Remote APIs. It does not fork Harness or copy the subscription plugin. API keys go into DSH's credential store, not the provider configuration or browser storage.

## Install

Use a DSH profile with the native `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter enabled (standard profiles already supply it). Install the prebuilt GitHub package:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub
```

If subscriptions are not installed in the same profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-subscriptions
```

Restart DSH, then open **Settings → Providers**. For a web profile, substitute `web` for `desktop`. If the subscription plugin is already installed, keep that installation. A standalone archive is also available under [Releases](https://github.com/arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub/releases). Download it and pass its local `.tgz` path to the same `dsh plugin add` command.

## Use

**BharatCode:** select BharatCode, enter your key, optionally discover the account's current models, review model capacities, and save. Select the provider/model in the conversation model picker. The preset uses `https://bharatcode.ai/api/model/v1`; its initial model IDs and capacities are defaults from the local integration, not a guarantee of current account availability.

**Other endpoints:** select Add OpenAI-compatible, give it a unique route ID, enter the API base URL (include `/v1` or the gateway prefix), pick its API format and enter its key. Discover models or add IDs manually. Endpoints without discovery are supported through manual entries. A localhost server that accepts any key may use a placeholder key. Remote endpoints require HTTPS.

**Subscriptions:** expand Manage subscription sign-in to use the installed plugin's original controls. ChatGPT subscriptions authenticate as Codex; GitHub subscriptions mean GitHub Copilot. An ordinary GitHub account does not itself provide paid Copilot models. Subscription inference and subscription account limits remain the upstream plugin's responsibility.

Keys are never read back into the form. A blank key field keeps the stored key or the exported environment variable named in Key reference. The hub preserves route options such as headers, reasoning compatibility, retries and timeouts, and keeps existing per-model advanced options when a matching ID is retained. It uses the namespace's revision to reject stale saves. If settings save succeeds but credential storage fails, the page explains the partial save and asks you to retry the key.

Model discovery runs inside the host. Missing context/output capacities use editable estimates of 32,768/4,096 tokens. Review these before saving. Discovery replaces the draft model list; saved models are the IDs in that draft. The hub does not remove existing routes; use DSH's native Models settings for advanced editing/removal.

## Existing integrations considered

- [V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions](https://github.com/V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions): selected for subscription support; covers ChatGPT/Codex and Copilot plus Claude, Grok and Antigravity.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-subscriptions](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-subscriptions): a broader subscription bridge; an alternative, not validated with this hub.
- [xxww0098/dsh-plugin-oauth-subs](https://github.com/xxww0098/dsh-plugin-oauth-subs): another subscription bridge using proxy routes; an alternative, not validated with this hub.

## Development and validation

```sh
git clone https://github.com/arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub.git
cd dsh-provider-hub
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm test
DSH_SOURCE=/path/to/deepseek-harness npm run test:composition
npm pack

# Optional test against the real subscription UI and Harness slot registry:
DSH_SOURCE=/path/to/deepseek-harness \
SUBSCRIPTIONS_SOURCE=/path/to/unpacked/dsh-plugin-subscriptions \
  npm run test:compatibility
```

`test:composition` requires a built Harness checkout and Node 24. It creates an isolated temporary profile and local OpenAI-compatible test server, then exercises the real Loader, settings revision/write path, native credential store, model discovery, model catalog and streamed inference. It does not touch the desktop profile or use real account credentials. `npm test` runs standalone unit/UI tests without a Harness installation. `test:compatibility` additionally mounts the real subscription component and uses the real Harness slot registry. Subscription support is tested with the existing 0.9.7 settings component contract; future upstream UI changes may require adaptation.

Validation covers an isolated Harness composition and the subscription plugin 0.9.7 UI contract. It does not establish live BharatCode, ChatGPT or Copilot account inference.

plugins.description: Floating panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that lists, runs, and tails this workspace's npm scripts, with clickable output links
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-npm-script

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web 界面添加一个**悬浮按钮**，点击后按项目分组列出当前工作区下的所有 npm 命令，并可以直接运行、停止、查看输出。

> A floating button for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that lists every npm script in the current workspace, grouped by project, and runs them with live status and captured output.

## 功能

- **悬浮按钮** — 常驻界面右下角，不占用任何面板空间。
- **按项目分组** — 一个工作区可以有多个项目（monorepo、多个子目录），自动扫描每个 `package.json` 并按项目分组展示脚本。
- **运行状态可见** — 每个命令显示当前状态：**执行中** / **可执行** / **停止中**。常驻命令（如前端 `npm run dev`）会一直保持"执行中"，可以随时停止。
- **输出记录** — 查看命令执行时捕获的 stdout / stderr，运行中可实时轮询刷新。
- **网址可点击** — 输出中出现的 `http://` / `https://` 地址会自动变成链接，点击在浏览器新建标签页打开；面板顶部还会把本次运行出现过的所有地址汇总成一行快捷入口。前端 `npm run dev` 打印的调试地址可以直接点开。
- **中英双语** — 跟随 Harness 的界面语言。

## 安装

需要已安装并运行 DeepSeek Harness。以下两种方式任选其一。

### 方式一：Web 界面

1. 打开 Harness Web 界面，进入侧边栏的 **Plugins**（插件）页面。
2. 在安装输入框中填入：

   ```
   github:zouzhipeng/dsh-npm-script
   ```

3. 确认安装，并确保该 bundle 处于**启用**状态。
4. 刷新页面。

### 方式二：命令行

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zouzhipeng/dsh-npm-script
```

安装完成后，在 Web 界面的 Plugins 页面启用 **dsh-npm-script** bundle，然后刷新页面。

### 更新

重新执行一次安装即可拉取最新版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zouzhipeng/dsh-npm-script
```

### 卸载

在 Plugins 页面移除，或执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @zouzhipeng/dsh-npm-script
```

## 使用

1. 点击界面右下角的悬浮按钮，打开命令面板。
2. 面板按项目分组列出所有 `package.json` 中的 `scripts`。
3. 点击命令名开始执行；执行中的命令会显示停止按钮。
4. 点击命令查看它的输出记录。输出里的网址可以直接点击打开。

按 `Esc` 关闭面板；如果正在查看输出，第一次按 `Esc` 会先退回命令列表。

## 工作方式

插件由两半组成：

- **Host 半**（`index.js`）通过 Harness 的 `workspaceRegistry` 解析当前工作区，扫描其中的 `package.json`，并通过 `subprocess` 服务启动脚本。所有 HTTP 路由都限制为仅本机回环访问。
- **Client 半**（`client.js`）通过 `shell.overlay` 插槽渲染悬浮按钮和面板，从 Host 的同源 JSON 路由获取数据。

执行脚本时会注入 `NO_COLOR=1`、`TERM=dumb`、`PAGER=cat`、`GIT_PAGER=cat`，让工具输出纯文本，这样打印出来的地址才能被完整识别为链接。客户端另外会剥离 ANSI 转义序列作为兜底。

## 配置

插件支持以下可选项（在 profile 的 `cordis.yml` 中通过 `config` 覆盖）：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scanDepth` | `3` | 扫描 `package.json` 的最大目录深度。 |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `262144` | 每个输出流在内存中保留的最大字节数（保留末尾）。 |
| `maxSpillBytes` | `8388608` | 溢出到磁盘的最大字节数。 |
| `graceMs` | `5000` | 停止命令时，等待进程优雅退出的毫秒数，超时后强制终止。 |
| `historyLimit` | `20` | 保留的历史运行记录条数。 |
| `scanCacheMs` | `5000` | 项目扫描结果的缓存毫秒数。 |

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness，profile 为 `web`。
- 仅支持 macOS / Linux / Windows 上 Harness 本身支持的平台。
- 命令来源仅限 `package.json` 的 `scripts` 字段。

## 已知限制

- 输出中仅 `http://` 与 `https://` 地址会被识别为链接（`ws://` 不识别，因为它无法在浏览器中直接打开）。
- 命令列表来自 `package.json` 的 `scripts`，不包含任意 npm 子命令。
- Host 半的代码改动需要重启 `dsh web` 才能生效（Harness 默认不对 Host 侧模块做热加载）；Client 半的改动刷新页面即可。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: AI生成。DSH 文件查重插件：按 SHA-256 内容哈希找出重复文件，可视化面板 + 对话工具，隔离区可恢复 | DSH file dedupe plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-file-dedupe

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）文件查重插件：扫描任意本地目录，按 **SHA-256 内容哈希**找出**内容完全相同**的重复文件，并安全地清理。

一句话价值：**装完就能在界面左下角点「🔍 文件查重」，几十秒内知道哪些文件是重复的、能腾出多少空间。**

- **可视化面板**：应用左下角常驻的「🔍 文件查重」浮动按钮（点开即面板），以及 **设置 → 文件查重** 区块。
- **对话工具**：`file_dedupe_scan` / `file_dedupe_cleanup` / `file_dedupe_restore`，直接让 Agent 帮你查。
- **安全设计**：只处理确实属于某个重复组的路径；每个重复组永远至少保留一个文件；Agent 工具只能把冗余副本移入**可恢复的隔离区**，永久删除必须由你在面板里二次确认。

## 安装

从 GitHub 直接安装（推荐）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zizhuang/dsh-file-dedupe
```

把 `web` 换成你的 profile 名（`desktop`、`headless`、`tui` 等）。安装后重启/刷新即可看到浮动按钮。

> 尚未发布到 npm（因此 `add dsh-file-dedupe` 暂时不可用）；被社区插件市场收录后，也可以在应用内「设置 → 插件市场」一键安装。

## 工作原理

1. 遍历目标目录，先按**文件大小**分组；
2. 只对「同大小且存在多个成员」的候选文件做 **SHA-256** 哈希（1 MiB 流式分块，大文件不占内存）；
3. 内容哈希相同的文件即为真重复——与文件名无关。

结果包含：重复组数、冗余文件数、可释放空间、每组文件清单。

## 清理方式

| 操作 | 入口 | 可恢复 |
|---|---|---|
| 移入隔离区 | 面板 + `file_dedupe_cleanup` | ✅ 用 `file_dedupe_restore` 恢复 |
| 永久删除 | 仅面板，需二次确认 | ❌ |

隔离文件存放于 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-file-dedupe/quarantine/`，并记录清单；恢复时精确回到原路径（目标位置已被占用则拒绝覆盖）。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `minFileSize` | `1` | 忽略小于该字节数的文件 |
| `maxFiles` | `100000` | 单次扫描最多收录的文件数 |
| `maxGroups` | `500` | 展示的重复组上限（按可释放空间排序） |

## 对话工具示例

```
file_dedupe_scan(root="D:\\file store")            → 重复组清单 + 可释放空间
file_dedupe_cleanup(scanId="scan-…", paths=[…])    → 把冗余副本移入隔离区
file_dedupe_restore(paths=[…])                     → 从隔离区恢复
```

## 注意事项

- 查重是**字节级内容相同**判定：同名不同内容不算重复，不同名同内容算重复。
- 超大目录扫描需要时间，可用 `minFileSize` / `maxFiles` 缩小范围。
- 清理只影响你勾选的冗余副本，每组永远至少保留一个文件。

## 兼容性

在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`（Windows 桌面版）上实测通过：安装、宿主路由、浮动按钮/设置面板、扫描 → 隔离 → 恢复全流程。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 桌面版标题栏重启按钮：一键重启整个应用（含 shell 与宿主进程）。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-restart

给 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**加一个**重启按钮**：点一下就把整个应用重启，回到原来的工作区。

## 简介

DSH 桌面版（Electron 外壳 + 它管理的服务端进程）没有提供任何界面内的重启入口：改完插件的服务端代码后，只能退出托盘再从快捷方式重新打开。本插件补上这个入口——一个直接落在窗口标题栏的重启按钮。

插件是普通 DSH 插件包，安装在你的 DSH profile 里（`desktop` 或 `web`），不修改 DSH 自身文件。按钮只有一个，**没有「关闭」**。

```
        ┌─────────────────────────────── 标题栏 ───────────────────────────────┐
        │  应用  编辑                                   [ ↻ ]   —    ❐    ✕     │
        └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                    ↑ 本插件        ↑ 系统原生按钮
```

## 功能特性

* **标题栏重启按钮**：位于标题栏最右侧、系统窗口控制按钮（— ❐ ✕）的左边，点击即重启整个应用。
* **只有重启，没有关闭**：不会误触退出，也不会触发外壳的崩溃恢复对话框。
* **按钮总在**：没有桌面标题栏的环境（例如浏览器里的 `dsh web`、macOS 桌面）自动回退到会话头部工具区，渲染同一个按钮，两种位置互斥。
* **重启期间有反馈**：先出现整屏「DSH 正在重启…」提示，再整体退出并自动重新打开；失败时弹出错误气泡并给出日志位置。
* **零第三方依赖**：不使用运行时依赖，不联网下载任何东西。

## 安装

插件托管在 GitHub（`kee0012/dsh-restart`，未发布到 npm），DSH 支持以 git 依赖方式直接安装：

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐，日常使用；拉取默认分支最新提交）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:kee0012/dsh-restart
```

> 安装后需要**重启 DSH**，新的服务端代码与 client bundle 才会生效。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-restart`，然后重启 DSH。

## 使用

1. 安装并重启 DSH 后，标题栏右侧会出现一个环形箭头按钮（标题栏不可用时则在会话头部）。
2. 悬停可见提示「立即重启 DeepSeek Harness（当前运行中的任务会中断）」。
3. 点击 → 出现「DSH 正在重启…」整屏提示 → 应用整体退出并自动重新打开 → 回到原来的工作区。
4. 若应用没有自动回来，按提示手动启动 DSH 即可；具体原因记录在日志里（见下一节）。

## 配置

无需配置，安装后即可使用。按钮位置按系统原生窗口按钮的宽度自动计算（见「已知限制」）。

## 兼容性

* **Profile**：`desktop`（桌面版，按钮落在窗口标题栏）与 `web`（`dsh web`，按钮落在会话头部工具区）。
* **操作系统**：Windows 桌面版为主要目标；macOS 桌面与 `dsh web` 走同构的 POSIX 路径。
* **运行环境**：Windows 需要 PowerShell 5.1+（系统自带）。不依赖 Node 之外的任何运行时。

## 实现方式

插件注册一个同源 HTTP 路由，由一段临时脚本在应用外部重启整个应用；脚本经 .NET 进程接口创建并 `detached` 脱离 DSH 的进程树（否则它会随被关闭的进程一起消失），关闭旧实例、等端口释放后重新拉起应用，并在任务结束时删除自己。脚本内含宿主的环境变量快照，因此只写在当前用户的临时目录、任务结束即自删；同目录还有一份诊断日志，仅在排查「点了没反应」时才有用。

「应用是否已经在运行」不靠进程名或父子关系判断，而是**认它的窗口**：枚举顶层窗口，只有属于本应用、可见、没有 owner、且窗口类名恰为 `Chrome_WidgetWin_1` 的才算一个实例。原因是打包后的 CLI 会在应用退出后留下一个没有窗口的 `dsh-desktop-host` 孤儿进程（父进程已死，于是它看起来也像「树根」），按进程关系判断会把它当成正在运行的应用，于是旧实例被关掉后再也不会有新的被拉起来。窗口探测失败时只记日志并照常拉起，绝不把「探测不出来」当成「已经在运行」。

## 已知限制

* 重启是**整应用级**的：所有窗口与未保存的输入都会一起消失（这是桌面版外壳的设计使然——只重启服务端会被判成崩溃）。
* **服务端代码不热重载**：修改插件 `src/` 后需要重新构建并**重启 DSH**，改动才生效。
* 标题栏按钮的位置按原生窗口按钮的宽度估算；若系统使用超大字号或非默认 DPI 缩放导致原生按钮变宽，按钮可能与其重叠或留缝。
* macOS 桌面的按钮落位与 Windows 相同，但重启路径（终止进程后重新打开应用）**尚未在真机验证**。
* Windows 依赖 PowerShell；它不可用时插件会退回到较弱的启动方式，重启可能失败（日志里有记录）。
* 助手脚本先用进程外的 .NET 进程接口拉起，且**必须回报一次「我已就位」宿主才继续**：脚本第一句会写一个就绪标记，宿主等到标记才去关闭应用。若助手没能起来，宿主会直接放弃这次重启并留下日志，而**不会**先把应用关掉——「关了却回不来」正是这条就绪握手机制要防的事。
* 与社区插件 `PangXitong/dsh-restart-button` 同时安装会出现两个重启入口，建议只保留一个。

## 反馈与贡献

发现了 bug 或有功能建议，欢迎在 [Issues](https://github.com/kee0012/dsh-restart/issues) 中反馈。提 PR 前请先跑通通用的构建与检查命令。

### 从源码构建

```sh
npm run bundle   # src/ → lib/（零依赖，仅用 Node 内置模块）
npm run gates    # 产物一致性门禁
npm test         # 单元与集成测试
npm run test:e2e # 助手脚本自删与重拉（会真的起进程，但不动正在运行的应用）
npm run test:sim # 启动握手离线取证：只报 pid 而不真启动的 launcher 必须被判失败
```

`src/` 是唯一的手写来源，`lib/` 由构建脚本生成，请不要手改 `lib/`。

## 许可证

MIT。重启按钮的落位思路参考了社区插件 `PangXitong/dsh-restart-button` 的公开实现（Apache-2.0）；本仓库为独立重写，只保留重启功能。

plugins.description: Keep the DeepSeek Harness host awake during active tasks with native power assertions.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-keep-awake

DeepSeek Harness 主机保活插件：AI 任务运行时自动保持主机亮屏、防止休眠，全部任务结束后释放保活请求。

## 插件介绍

- 保活由 DSH 后端控制，支持多个会话和子 Agent；关闭网页或切换到后台不影响运行中的任务。
- 在侧边栏的**设置同一行**显示太阳图标，点击可查看状态、运行任务数量，以及开启或关闭保活。
- 使用普通用户权限的临时电源断言，不需要管理员权限，不修改全局电源设置，不模拟鼠标或键盘。
- Windows 使用 Power Request，macOS 使用 IOKit，Linux 使用 D-Bus ScreenSaver 和 logind。系统接口不可用时会显示部分生效或失败状态。
- 主机开关作用于当前 DSH 进程，重启后默认开启。插件停止或宿主退出时释放请求。

保护对象是**运行 DSH 后端的设备**。手动锁屏、合盖及系统强制策略可能覆盖保活。Linux 已实机验证；Windows 和 macOS 已实现，尚待实机验证。针对 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 开发。

## 安装方法

### 从 npm 安装（推荐）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @zi7tian/dsh-keep-awake
```

### 从 GitHub 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zi7tian/dsh-keep-awake
```

### 本地安装

```sh
git clone https://github.com/zi7tian/dsh-keep-awake.git
cd dsh-keep-awake
npm ci
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-keep-awake
```

将路径替换为实际插件目录，Windows 使用对应本地路径。插件依赖 Koffi，安装时会获取适合当前平台的原生组件；Linux 还需要系统提供 `libdbus-1` 及相应的会话服务。

安装或升级后，等待当前任务结束，**重启 `dsh web` 并刷新页面**。设置旁出现太阳图标即表示控制面板已加载。桌面版请通过其插件管理器安装。

### 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @zi7tian/dsh-keep-awake
```

plugins.description: dsh-update-vd
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-update-vd

> DSH Desktop 更新中心：**侧栏版本号** + **一条「更新」按钮** + **带进度条的更新弹窗**，
> 下载完自动替换 `/Applications` 里的 app 并重启 —— 不用再把 DMG 里的 app 手动拖进 Applications。

一个基于 **DeepSeek Harness / DSH Desktop** 的 Cordis 插件（宿主端 + 客户端），把 DSH Desktop 的
更新体验换成一条自动链路；另外给设置面板加了 **技能**、**MCP**、**智能体（Agent 预设）**、**导入**
四页（「导入」＝ 从本机其它 AI 工具把智能体预设 / 对话记录搬进来，v1.9.1 从智能体页搬出来独立成页），
技能 / MCP / 智能体都支持按「源地址」联网搜索与一键取用。侧栏还带一个**笔记**弹窗；
**设置 → 账号与余额** 的「充值余额」下面还有一张 **Token 活动**热力图（一天一格，每天 / 每周 / 年 / 累计总量四种模式）。

---

## ✨ 功能

### 1. 侧栏底部那一行（账号行上面）
- 平时：`版本 2.0.16` + `[检查更新]`
- 有新版本：`2.0.16 → 2.0.17` + 高亮的 `[更新]`
- 下载中：`正在下载 28%` + 一条细进度条
- 取消过 / 断网过：`[继续下载]`（**断点续传**）
- 侧栏收起成窄栏时是一个图标按钮，有新版本时带一个小圆点

### 2. 更新弹窗
| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 正在下载 | 「升级 APP / 正在为您更新，请耐心等待 / 已下载 28%」+ 进度条 + `[取消] [后台升级]` |
| 点 **取消** | **二次确认**：「确定要取消下载吗？」`[继续下载] [确定取消]`，并说明已下载的部分会保留 |
| 点 **空白处** / Esc | 隐藏弹窗 = **后台升级**（下载继续，侧栏那行继续显示百分比）。二次确认开着时，点空白处只收回确认 |
| 取消过 / 失败过 | 提示「上次已下载 32%，从断点继续」，点继续就是**接着下**（HTTP Range），不从头来 |
| 下载完成 | 自动挂载 DMG → 校验版本与签名 → 替换 app → 自动重启 |

### 3. 装机细节
- 全程只请求 `dshdesktop.cn` 两个固定端点，重定向到别的主机直接拒绝。
- 安装前先整份 `ditto` 到暂存目录并 `codesign --verify --deep --strict` 验签，
  通过之后才「移开旧的 / 换上新的」（任一步失败都把旧的搬回来）。
- 退出旧 app 用三保险：`killall -TERM <CFBundleExecutable>` → `osascript … quit` →
  等它的 HTTP 端口关掉，超时再 `killall -KILL`。

### 4. 设置 → **技能**（`settings.section` = skills）
- 列出所有技能（含随包发布的、项目里的，只读的会标出来），带来源与磁盘路径；
- **搜索**（名字 / 描述）；**新增**、**编辑**（改名字 / 描述 / Markdown 正文）；
- **删除**要二次确认（并显示会被删掉的路径）；
- **导入**：给一个 http/https 地址（抓 SKILL.md），或给一个本机路径（技能目录 / 单个 .md）；
  重名会明确报错，不覆盖。
- 可写目录：`~/.dsh/skills`、`~/.agents/skills`（随包 / 项目里的只展示，不改写）。

### 5. 设置 → **MCP**（`settings.section` = mcp）
- 列出 MCP 服务器（名字 / 类型 / 地址或命令 / 是否连上）；
- **搜索**、**新增**、**编辑**、**删除**（要确认）、**启用 / 停用**；
- 两种类型都支持：`streamable-http`（URL + 请求头）与 `stdio`（命令 + 参数 + 环境变量）；
- 清单存在 `~/.dsh/mcp-servers.json`，保存后**立刻挂载/断开**（内部按 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`
  的行来动态挂载），不用改 profile 的 patch，也不用重启。连不上会明确告诉你哪个服务器、什么原因。

### 6. 设置 → **智能体**（`settings.section` = agents，排在「MCP」后面）

> 「**从其它 AI 导入**」v1.9.1 起**不在这一页里了** —— 它搬成了导航里「智能体」**下面**独立的一页
> 「**导入**」（`settings.section` = `other-ai`，order 160），见下面第 9 节。

管的是 DSH 的 **Agent 预设**：一个预设就是一行 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` 声明，
`config.plugins`（正文）决定这个智能体能用哪些插件/工具。

- **列表**：内置的（`standard` / `ptc` / `minimal` / `cordis`，随 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 发布）、
  你/别人随包装的、以及本插件自己加的都在一起。每条显示名字、来源徽标、简介（截断两行）、
  标识、插件数 / 工具行数；装配失败的会标红并把 DSH 给的诊断原样贴出来；
- **搜索**：按名字 / 标识 / 简介 / 来源实时过滤；
- **新建 / 编辑 / 删除**：标识 + 名字 + 简介 + 排序 + 模型备注 + 正文（DSH patch 的条目清单 YAML）。
  正文也可以勾「这段是系统提示词」直接写一段话（保存时自动包成一行 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona`）。
  删除要**二次确认**；
- **内置的只读，但可以「复制一份」**：选它的理由 —— 内置预设随包发布、重启/升级会被覆盖，
  允许改会造成「我改的东西下次更新就没了」的错觉；而拦住用户又不合适，所以给一条明确的出路：
  任意预设（含内置）都能「复制一份」成自己的副本再改；
- **导入**：粘贴内容 / 选本地文件 / 给本机路径 / 给 http(s) 地址，四种随便挑一种。
  重名会明确报错，并给出「自动改个名字」和「覆盖同名自定义预设」两个显式选项 —— **不会静默覆盖**；
- **导出**：单条导出 + 全部导出，下载成文件（Blob + `createObjectURL` + `<a download>`）。
  两种格式：本插件 JSON（再导入时名字/简介/模型备注一起还原）、DSH 补丁 YAML（贴进 bundle 就能用）；
- **在线搜索 + 装第三方**：见下面第 7 节；
- **从其它 AI 导入**：见下面第 9 节 —— v1.9.1 起它是设置里**独立的一页**（导航「导入」，排在「智能体」下面），
  这一页不再有那个入口按钮。

数据落在 `~/.dsh/agent-presets.json`。保存后在运行时动态挂载那一行声明
（跟 MCP 一个套路：`ctx.plugin(模块, config)`），所以**不用改 profile 的 patch、也不用重启**；
删掉就是 dispose，`agentPresets` 注册表里同步消失。第三方预设如果引用的插件包没装，
它会留在列表里并标成「装配失败」，把 DSH 的报错原样显示出来 —— 装好那个包再重启 DSH 即可。

### 7. 在线搜索（三个页面都有，**多个源可选**）

技能页进「导入」就能看到；MCP 页与智能体页点「在线搜索」。选一个**源地址** → 填关键字 → 搜索 → 一键取用。

| 页面 | 内置源 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 技能 | `anthropics/skills` | Anthropic 官方技能库（20+ SKILL.md） |
| 技能 | `obra/superpowers` | 社区技能合集 |
| 技能 | 自定义地址… | 填 `owner/repo` 或完整 GitHub 链接（任何放 SKILL.md 的仓库都能搜） |
| MCP | MCP 官方注册表 | `registry.modelcontextprotocol.io`，按关键字搜，结果自带 `streamable-http` URL 或 stdio 启动命令 |
| MCP | `modelcontextprotocol/servers` | 官方参考实现（自动填成 `npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-<名字>`） |
| MCP | 自定义地址… | 别的注册表 URL，或 `owner/repo` |
| 智能体 | **本机自带预设** | 直接读随包的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/*.patch.yml`（离线可用；取用＝复制一份成自定义） |
| 智能体 | `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` | 上游官方预设集合（standard / ptc / minimal / cordis） |
| 智能体 | `AcidGr/dsh-preset-mobile-use` | 第三方预设（手机自动化 Agent），**装它＝把别人的插件行挂进你的 DSH** |
| 智能体 | 自定义地址… | `owner/repo`，或一个 `.patch.yml` 的完整 https 地址 |

- 技能：搜到直接「导入这个」→ 抓 raw 的 SKILL.md 存成 `~/.dsh/skills/<名字>/SKILL.md`；
- MCP：搜到点「用它新建」→ 表单自动填好，确认后再保存（保存即挂载）；
- 智能体：搜到点「装到本机」→ 抓那份 patch、把里面的预设声明写进本机清单并**立刻挂载**（默认自动改名，不覆盖你已有的）。
  智能体的源是「扫仓库里所有 patch 文件，找带 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` 声明的」，所以任何按
  DSH 约定发布预设的仓库都能当源；
- **智能体的搜索结果有 10 分钟缓存**：一次搜索要花十几次 GitHub 请求，而未登录配额只有 60 次/小时，
  所以同一个仓库 10 分钟内换关键字重搜是 0 次请求（结果里会写「N 秒前抓的缓存」）；
- 都是公开只读接口、不需要 key。GitHub 未登录配额 60 次/小时，所以仓库清单有 10 分钟缓存；
- 搜索失败会把真实原因（HTTP 状态 / 认不出的地址）原样显示出来，不吞。

### 8. 从本机其它 AI 工具导入（技能 / MCP 两页有）

| 页面 | 从哪读 | 读到什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 技能 | `~/.codex/skills/*/SKILL.md`、`~/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`、`~/.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md` | 勾选后复制进 `~/.dsh/skills/<名字>/`（同名会标出来，不覆盖） |
| MCP | Codex `~/.codex/config.toml`（含 `[mcp_servers.X.env]`）、Claude `~/.claude.json`、Cursor `~/.cursor/mcp.json`、Windsurf、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、Continue | 勾选后写进清单并**立刻挂载**；没连上会在界面上说清楚是哪个、为什么 |

实测这台机器：从 Codex 扫到 **12 个技能 + 4 个 MCP 服务器**，从 Claude 扫到 1 个，导入后文件真的落到 `~/.dsh/skills/`、清单真的落盘、挂载真的被调用（生成的配置还拿 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 的官方 Zod schema 校验过）。

### 9. 从其它 AI 导入（设置里**独立的一页**：导航「导入」，在「智能体」下面）

导航里点「**导入**」→ 就是这一页（`settings.section` 的 `other-ai`，order 160，排在「智能体」150 下面；
v1.9.1 从「智能体」页**搬出来**，那边的入口按钮已经删掉），里面有**两个页签**：

| 页签 | 导什么 |
| --- | --- |
| **智能体预设**（默认） | 那几家里的「智能体 / 提示词 / 技能」，导成 DSH 智能体预设（见下面 9.1） |
| **对话记录** | 那几家里的**历史会话**，导成**真正的 DSH 会话**（能在左侧会话列表打开、能接着聊；见下面 9.2） |

#### 9.1 智能体预设页签

默认四个来源，**装了就把里面的智能体/提示词一键导成 DSH 智能体预设**，没装就**照旧显示出来**并给官网入口
（`window.open` 新窗口）—— 不把没装的藏起来。

| 来源 | 探测判据 | 能导入什么 | 官网 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Codex** | `~/.codex` 存在 | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md`（它的全局指令文件）、`~/.codex/prompts/*.md` | [developers.openai.com/codex](https://developers.openai.com/codex/) |
| **Claude Code** | `~/.claude/agents` 或 `~/.claude` 存在 | `~/.claude/agents/*.md`（子代理：`name`/`description` 来自 frontmatter，正文＝系统提示词）、`~/.claude/commands/*.md` | [claude.com/product/claude-code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code) |
| **TRAE** | `/Applications/Trae.app`（国内版 `Trae CN.app`）或 `trae` CLI **并且** 配置目录在 | `~/.trae/skills/*/SKILL.md`、`~/.trae/memory/user_profile.md`、`~/.trae-cn/skills/*/SKILL.md` | [trae.cn](https://www.trae.cn/) |
| **WorkBuddy** | `~/.workbuddy` 存在 | `SOUL.md`（人格总纲）/ `IDENTITY.md`（身份卡）/ `USER.md`（用户画像）、`~/.workbuddy/skills/*/SKILL.md` | [workbuddy.ai](https://www.workbuddy.ai/) |

- **Codex 没有「子代理」这个概念**，所以能导的是「全局指令 + 提示词」，界面上写明了它们是它的全局指令文件；
- **TRAE 是特例**：光有 `~/.trae` / `~/.trae-cn` 只是别的工具留下的配置残渣，必须 app 或 CLI 在才算「装了」，
  否则界面上标「只有配置残渣」并显示下载入口。它自带的重型技能包（`builtin_skills` 等）故意不列 ——
  几十上百 KB 且依赖它的运行时，导过来没有意义；
- **导入的形态**：因为这几家都不是 DSH 预设格式，统一转成「一段系统提示词」的 DSH 智能体预设
  （正文就是一行 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona`），落到 `~/.dsh/agent-presets.json` 并**立刻挂载**。
  撞内置/撞已有都会**明确报错**，可以勾「重名自动改名」导成副本；只有「同一来源的同一项再导一次」
  才当作幂等刷新（不然连点两次就报错太蠢）；

# VectorCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![VectorCraft Use — editable vector brand assets](assets/official-logo.png)

> Turn a brand brief into an editable native VectorCraft project — logo, icon set, infographic or chart — and revise it object by object instead of re-drawing it.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](https://github.com/full-aigc-plugins/vectorcraft-plugin/releases)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-25-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20tools-40-00A67E)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`vectorcraft` connects a coding agent to the real VectorCraft engine, so a task ends with a native `.vectorcraft` project you can reopen and keep editing, not just a flattened picture. The plugin owns workflow skills, a pinned first-use CLI installer, and a same-session editor bridge; it does not re-implement the editor, the renderer, or the file format.

| Property | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| Plugin ID | `vectorcraft` |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.2` |
| Status | Development preview; full domain and all-host acceptance still open |
| Editor runtime | Node.js 24, started from `ui/bootstrap.mjs` |
| Native CLI | `vectorcraft-cli` maintained build `0.2.0-craft.2`, derived from upstream `v0.2.0` |
| Verified CLI platform | macOS arm64 with Python 3.11 or newer |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

Current plugin: `0.1.0-dev.20261019.1`; skill source: `0.1.0-dev.47`; version roles are independent.

| Identity | Current value |
| --- | --- |
| Metadata version | 0.1.0-dev.20261019.1 |
| Skills source | vectorcraft-skills / 0.1.0-dev.47 |


## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 24 on `PATH`. The bundled stdio MCP server runs on it (`package.json` pins `>=24 <25`).
- For the CLI skills: macOS arm64 and Python 3.11 or newer. The first use installs the pinned `vectorcraft-cli` into your user data directory; nothing is written to `PATH` and `sudo` is not used.
- Network access on the first editor launch. The plugin downloads and verifies the pinned editor archive; a complete release ZIP already contains it, and no Rust toolchain or `npm install` is needed.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add vectorcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

Restart the host, open a new task, and ask VectorCraft to open the editor for your workspace.

### Other host manifests

| Host | Manifest | Path base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Agent Plugins 1.0.0 | `plugin.json`, `mcp.json` | `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` |
| Codex | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `.codex-plugin/mcp.json` | plugin root relative to `cwd` |
| Claude Code | `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.mcp.json` | `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` |

Kimi loads the same skill set through `kimi.plugin.json`. The plugin does not guess absolute paths. In a development checkout you must build the editor assets first; cloning the source is not an installed runtime.

## Quick start

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Install plugin] --> B[Restart and open a task]
    B --> C[open_editor / open_browser_editor]
    C --> D{editor_status ready?}
    D -->|No| C
    D -->|Yes| E[command_list]
    E --> F[command_run]
    F --> G[Inspect, save, export]
```

1. Open the editor with an explicit `workspace` argument — the folder holding your files, not the plugin folder.
2. Wait for `editor_status` before editing; instructions sent earlier act on an unattached page.
3. Read `command_list` (or `list_commands` for the shorter panel catalogue), then act with `command_run` / `command_batch`.
4. Save the native project, close it, and reopen it to confirm the objects are still editable.
5. Export only what you verified; the native file stays the source of truth.

For the CLI path, the skills run the pinned binary through the bundled harness:

```bash
python3 -I -B skills/vectorcraft-harness/scripts/cli.py -- --version
python3 -I -B skills/vectorcraft-harness/scripts/cli.py -- commands
```

Both commands prove installation and discovery only; they are not creative acceptance.

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Logo system with mono and reversed variants | `vectorcraft-logo-system`, `vectorcraft-cli-artboards` | Native artboards, one per variant, with distinct IDs |
| Consistent icon set | `vectorcraft-icon-set`, `vectorcraft-cli-shapes` | Icons on named artboards, editable paths |
| Infographic for a process or dataset | `vectorcraft-infographic`, `vectorcraft-editable-chart` | Live text and `create_graph` charts, not baked images |
| Trace a bitmap back to vectors | `vectorcraft-trace-artwork`, `vectorcraft-cli-paths` | Rebuilt paths plus the original as a reference layer |
| Clipped illustration and sticker sheets | `vectorcraft-clipped-illustration`, `vectorcraft-sticker-grid`, `vectorcraft-sticker-offset-border` | Releasable clipping groups, resizable arrays, offset outlines |
| Recolor a brand without touching neighbours | `vectorcraft-cli-appearance`, `vectorcraft-cli-selection` | Changed bound variants, unchanged unrelated objects |
| Multi-artboard delivery | `vectorcraft-cli-export` + `export` tool | SVG, PDF, raster or template output per artboard range |

The plugin never rewrites the upstream editor and never silently changes a deliverable format. Rasterized effects are reported instead of being hidden.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
| :--- | :--- |
| `vectorcraft-use` | Main entry: routes a request to the narrowest skill and keeps the native project as the deliverable |
| `vectorcraft-harness` | Shared execution channel: pinned CLI bootstrap, command gateway, workflow and desktop session scripts |
| `vectorcraft-cli` | Command catalogue, argv contract, selection by attribute and bounded rework |
| `vectorcraft-cli-setup` | First install, digest check, version check and broken-runtime diagnosis |
| `vectorcraft-cli-project` | Create, reopen and save projects; layer organisation; document colour mode |
| `vectorcraft-cli-shapes` | Compose shapes, reflect, shear, align, distribute and change object bounds |
| `vectorcraft-cli-paths` | Edit anchors and handles; outline, offset, simplify and clean paths |
| `vectorcraft-cli-selection` | Select by attribute, lock, hide, isolate and limit the edit scope |
| `vectorcraft-cli-appearance` | Brand colours, fill, stroke, transparency and appearance variants |
| `vectorcraft-cli-boolean` | Pathfinder, compound paths and shape-builder operations |
| `vectorcraft-cli-text` | Logo and brand text, font dependencies and outlined export |
| `vectorcraft-cli-artboards` | Multi-artboard logo/icon layouts and size variants |
| `vectorcraft-cli-assets` | Place assets, manage links and symbols, trace existing images |
| `vectorcraft-cli-export` | Vector exchange formats, previews and multi-artboard asset bundles |
| `vectorcraft-editor` | Open the real editor in the host, bind the workspace, mirror agent actions on the page |
| `vectorcraft-logo-system` | Vector logos, monochrome and reversed variants |
| `vectorcraft-icon-set` | One visual style across a set of vector icons |
| `vectorcraft-infographic` | Process, structure and data-explanation graphics |
| `vectorcraft-trace-artwork` | Bitmap-to-vector reconstruction for marks and line art |
| `vectorcraft-editable-chart` | Charts that stay editable inside a report |
| `vectorcraft-svg-cleanup` | SVG size, path and compatibili

# dsh-learning-gap-check — Competency gap and development plan register check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-learning-gap-check?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-learning-gap-check?ref=badge)

`dsh-learning-gap-check` reads one competency-gap and development-plan register — the employee header plus one row per competency — and checks that register's own arithmetic and closure: that each gap names its position and competency, that the recorded levels parse as numbers, that the gap equals the required level minus the actual level, that a gap beyond your configured threshold carries a development action, that an action names an owner and a due date, that the completion date is not later than the deadline, and that the action status comes from your own vocabulary.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-learning-gap-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-learning-gap-check'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-learning-gap-check: document → rule pack → findings.](docs/assets/dsh-learning-gap-check-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: document → rule pack → findings. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `learning_gap_check`

**Input**

~~~json
{"employee":"张工","department":"设备部","rows":[{"岗位":"","能力项":"","要求等级":"4","现有等级":"2","差距等级":"2"}]}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-learning-gap-check.LG-001.de09b5a6",
  "ruleId": "LG-001",
  "severity": "warn",
  "locator": {
    "row": 1,
    "field": "position"
  },
  "found": "第 1 行 position、competency 都为空",
  "expected": "position、competency 至少应填写一项"
}
~~~

*Observed from `dsh-learning-gap-check/tests/fixtures/LG-001/LG-001-unsafe.json`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row carries the competency but leaves the position blank. | `LG-001` reports a row only when `position` and `competency` are both empty; one of the two filled is enough. It checks that the row names a post and a competency, not whether the competency requirement for that post is reasonable or complete. |
| Our levels are written as words (`熟练`, `掌握`) or as letters (`A`/`B`/`C`) — what happens? | `LG-002` reads `actualLevel` and requires it to parse as a number, so a level written as a word or a letter is reported as unparseable. The plugin ships no competency scale: convert the register to a numeric scale, or disable `LG-002` together with `LG-003`. Parseability is all it checks — whether the assessment was objective or accurate is not judged. |
| The gap column says `3`, but required `4` minus actual `2` is `2` — does that get caught? | `LG-003` recomputes `requiredLevel − actualLevel` with a tolerance of `0` and reports the row whose stored `gapLevel` disagrees. It runs only when all three columns hold parseable numbers; if one is missing the rule goes to `skipped`. A negative gap is reported as it stands, because the columns may have been transposed, and the rule does not decide how large a gap counts as a problem. |
| A row records a development action but no owner and no due date. | `LG-005` requires `owner` and `dueAt` on every row whose `action` is filled, and reports the row missing either one. It checks that the two fields are recorded; it does not judge whether the action is effective or the deadline reasonable. |
| A row's completion date is later than its due date, or the two columns were filled in the wrong order. | `LG-006` compares `dueAt` with `completedAt` on every row and reports the row when the due date falls before the completion date. The pack states its limit in its own words: it compares only the order of the two dates and does not decide whether the work was really completed on schedule. A date it cannot parse is reported in its own right instead of being passed over. |
| `LG-004` and `LG-007` never report anything — does that mean my register passed them? | No: both rules report themselves in `skipped`. `LG-004` ships with `threshold: 0`, which means unconfigured — set the gap size at which a development action becomes mandatory. `LG-007` ships with an empty status vocabulary — fill it from your institution's own wording. Once configured, `LG-004` checks only that the action column is filled and `LG-007` only that the status value is in your vocabulary; neither judges whether the action was really carried out. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《质量管理 能力管理和人员发展指南》 | GB/T 19025—2023（质量管理 能力管理和人员发展指南；2023-03-17 发布并实施；归口全国质量管理和质量保证标准化技术委员会；条号本次未取得） | LG-001, LG-002, LG-003, LG-005, LG-006 |
| 本机构培训与发展管理口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的差距阈值） | LG-004 |
| 本机构培训与发展管理口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的状态口径） | LG-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **能力差距与培养计划台账** for arithmetic and closure — that each gap names its
position and competency, that the two level columns parse as numbers, that the gap equals required minus actual,
that a gap beyond your threshold carries a development action, that an action names an owner and a due date, that
the completion date is not later than the deadline, and that the action status comes from your vocabulary. It does
**not** decide whether an employee is competent, whether an assessment was objective, whether a development action
worked, or whether someone should be reassigned or dismissed.

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin deliberately leaves out
>
> **It ships no competency scale, and it assumes the levels are numbers.** `LG-002` and `LG-003` read three
> numeric columns and check the arithmetic between them. A register using letter grades (`A`/`B`/`C`) or words
> (`熟练`/`掌握`) is **reported as unparseable**, because comparing such levels is a modelling decision the
> plugin will not make for you. Convert the scale, or disable those rules.
>
> **It ships no threshold for "big enough to need action".** How much of a gap obliges a development action is
> the institution's talent-management call — some units require one for any shortfall, others tolerate a step —
> so `LG-004`'s threshold starts at `0` and the rule reports itself in `skipped` until you set it.
>
> **The status vocabulary ships empty** for the same reason. And the date rule checks only that the deadline
> does not precede the completion date, which is a data-entry property: **it does not judge whether the work was
> done late.**
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained.** The regime
> lives in GB/T 19025 (identical to ISO 10015) and each institution's qualification and training rules. The
> verification pass could not retrieve verbatim clause text, so the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field
> itself and keeps every rule at `warn` or `info`. **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the
> real clause and raise `kind` to `direct`.**

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and is enforced by the host since 0.2.1 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native` and `ptc`; for a department's plan use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `learning_gap_check` tool. It reads one gap-and-plan register — the employee header plus one row per
competency — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LG-001` | the position and competency are recorded | warn | principle |
| `LG-002` | the actual level parses as a number | warn | principle |
| `LG-003` | the gap equals required minus actual | warn | principle |

# dsh-protest-deadline — Query and complaint register date and deadline check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-protest-deadline?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-protest-deadline?ref=badge)

`dsh-protest-deadline` reads one query-and-complaint register (质疑与投诉台账) — the project header plus one row per query — and checks what such a register can be held to mechanically: that the date the query was raised or the date it was answered is recorded, that the dates parse and follow one another, that the reply falls inside the deadline the register itself states, that every status comes from your own vocabulary, that the query numbers are unique, and that the header names the procurement project.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-protest-deadline
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-protest-deadline'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-protest-deadline: call → plugin → result.](docs/assets/dsh-protest-deadline-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: call → plugin → result. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `protest_deadline`

**Input**

~~~json
{"project":"某某设备采购项目","projectNo":"ZC-2026-018","rows":[{"序号":"ZY-2026-001","质疑人":"某某科技有限公司","质疑提出日期":"","答复收到日期":"2026-03-07","答复期限":"2026-03-09","实际答复日期":""}]}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-protest-deadline.PD-001.de09b5a6",
  "ruleId": "PD-001",
  "severity": "warn",
  "locator": {
    "row": 1,
    "field": "raisedAt"
  },
  "found": "第 1 行 raisedAt、replyAt 都为空",
  "expected": "raisedAt、replyAt 至少应填写一项",
  "fix": "补填质疑提出日期与答复日期；本条只核对是否填写，不判断是否在法定期限内"
}
~~~

*Observed from `dsh-protest-deadline/tests/fixtures/PD-001/PD-001-unsafe.json (cases.json expects 1×PD-001); executed parseMaterial+runCheck, checkedAt=2026-10-06T00:00:00.000Z`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row leaves both the date the query was raised and the date it was answered blank. Is that reported? | Yes. `PD-001` requires at least one of `raisedAt` and `replyAt` on every row and reports the row where both are empty. It checks only that one of the two is filled, not whether the query was raised inside the legal period: that needs the date the supplier knew of the harm, the service date and a working-day count a register usually does not carry. |
| The reply date is written earlier than the raise date. Is that caught? | `PD-002` compares the raise date with the reply date row by row and reports `raisedAt` when it is later than `replyAt`; the same day counts as not later. A value it cannot parse — `2026年3月15日`, say, where `2026-03-15`, `2026/3/15` or `2026-03-15 09:30` would be read — is reported on that row instead of being passed over quietly. The rule only orders the two dates the register carries. |
| Our reply went out after the reply deadline recorded in the register. Was it late? | `PD-003` hard-codes no day count and cannot say “late”: it compares the actual reply date with the deadline written in the register's own `replyDueAt` column, so a finding means “this disagrees with the deadline you recorded”. With that column empty there is nothing to compare against and the rule reports itself in `skipped`, rather than assuming a period. |
| The status column says 已答复, yet nothing came back for it. Why? | `PD-005` compares the status with the vocabulary you configure, and `values` ships empty, so as delivered the rule reports itself in `skipped` — the choice of values belongs to your institution, not to the engine — instead of passing silently. Fill `values` with your own list (待答复, 已答复, 已投诉, 已撤回, …) and any value not on it is reported row by row. It checks that the value is on the list, never how the query should be handled. |
| The header names the project but carries no header-level raise date. Is something missing? | No. `PD-006` checks the header for the procurement project only: its `fields` default to `[project]`, because the raise date is normally a per-row column. If your form does state it in the header, the rule's own note says to set `fields` to `[project, raisedAt]`. A missing project is reported against the header, not against a row. |
| The same query number appears on two rows. | `PD-007` reports the second row and names the first, comparing the numbers with whitespace ignored. A repeat usually means the same query was registered twice or a number was copied — telling those apart is a human call. If the register carries no number column, the rule reports that it does not apply rather than passing. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|

> ### ⚠️ What the citation rests on
>
> **《政府采购质疑和投诉办法》(财政部令第94号) was obtained and read verbatim** — the whole text, six chapters
> and forty-five articles — and `rules/evidence/clause-verification.md` records what was quoted:
